title: Unit
description: YAML front matter of course/units/NN-slug/unit.md. One week's subject (D-012).

accepted.description: The teacher's deliberate exceptions for THIS file (D-037). Each entry suppresses one validation rule's findings for this file; `classkit validate` still counts them, so they are never invisible. Only the teacher adds these — an agent never does so on its own.

rule.description: The rule code, as `classkit validate` prints it in brackets, e.g. 'in_class_missing'. Not pattern-checked on purpose: a mistyped code is reported by the advisory rule `unknown_rule`, never as a schema error (D-038).

reason.description: Why the departure is deliberate, e.g. 'holiday week — no class meeting'. Optional: a missing reason is reported by the advisory rule `accepted_without_reason`, never as a schema error (D-038).

prerequisites.description: Units that must precede this one.

difficulties.description: What students find hard in this unit — misconceptions, sticking points (D-046). Optional: in a newly flipped course the teacher may not know them yet. The class hour is built to repair these; the entry-quiz and class-hour agents read `origin` to know which are guesses.

text.description: The difficulty, in a sentence — e.g. 'Students read O(n) as an exact running time rather than an upper bound.'

origin.description: `teacher` — the teacher said so; `proposed` — an agent proposed it (a classic difficulty of a well-known subject) and the teacher accepted it, still a guess about these students.

approved.description: The teacher's approval of this unit — its milestone (D-046, spec §8.9). Written by `classkit approve unit N`, or by hand (then usually without `hash`). Editing afterwards is normal and un-approves nothing; `classkit status` uses the hash to say 'edited since'. Agents never write or change it.

stage.description: `planned` — the objectives were approved (/plan-units); the hash is over unit.md. `designed` — the whole unit was approved (/design-unit); the hash is over unit.md, its sessions, its in-class.md and its entry-quiz items.

hash.description: sha256 at approval, without this block (spec §8.9). Written by the tool; absent when approved by hand.

objectives.description: Unit Objectives — the thin abstract layer above Guiding Questions (D-012/Q-011). Teacher-facing: syllabus text, accreditation, prerequisite tracking.

outcomes.description: Course Outcomes (declared in syllabus/syllabus.md) this objective rolls up to (D-021). Not required by the schema — an objective naming none is advisory. Naming one the syllabus does not declare is an integrity error (`outcome_reference`, D-037).
